raw.thesis: narma is an "Enterprise Agentic Brain" for AI-first companies. It provides a three-layer architecture to observe work patterns, detect employee intent and task value, and automatically generate and deploy AI agents for high-ROI opportunities. The core innovation lies in its "Work Graph" approach, which focuses on revealing resource inefficiencies and identifying precise points where AI can intervene to provide assistance, rather than building new LLMs. The venture aims to help AI-first companies accurately measure AI savings, ensure reliable ROI, and manage workflow "drift." narma replaces the manual and often chaotic process of identifying and implementing AI automation within large enterprises, particularly those already committed to an AI-first strategy. By providing a structured, data-driven approach, it complements existing AI initiatives, enabling companies to move beyond initial AI experimentation to widespread, measurable deployment.

raw.product_description: narma is an "Enterprise Agentic Brain" designed for AI-first companies to identify, prove, and deploy AI automation at scale. It features a three-layer architecture: Observe (desktop sensors for work patterns), Intelligence Layer (a "Brain" detecting intent, task value, and drift), and Execution Layer (an "Agent Factory" for generating, deploying, and monitoring AI agents). The system leverages existing foundation models and focuses on a "Work Graph" to pinpoint inefficiencies and AI intervention points.
